mentions.note: Olympic 1500m bronze medallist; outkicked by Gladwin for second

photos.c: FRONT COVER. John Gladwin's summer has included a fine win in the U.K 1500m Championship. Here we see John with Seb Coe representing the U.K in June's Russia match. In windy conditions and after setting the early pace John outkicked Olympic 1500m bronze medallist Kirov(4) for second.

photo.caption: FRONT COVER. John Gladwin's summer has included a fine win in the U.K 1500m Championship. Here we see John with Seb Coe representing the U.K in June's Russia match. In windy conditions and after setting the early pace John outkicked Olympic 1500m bronze medallist Kirov(4) for second.
